purpose: Phase-7C Section 4 immune-escape runtime coefficients. Escape = the integrated outcome in which tumour cells avoid/resist/outlast otherwise-available immune pressure (DISTINCT from suppression, which is inhibitory pressure on immune function). Represented as MULTIPLE explicit dimensions (recognition / access / priming / effector / checkpoint-mediated / suppression-mediated / exhaustion-mediated / persistence) rather than one opaque score. Escape CONSUMES upstream blocked-potential records rather than re-applying raw penalties (no double counting). Magnitude and persistence are kept SEPARATE. No genetic adaptation / clonal evolution / acquired resistance here (that is Phase 8A). Prediction-only; schematic [0,1].

persistence.note: persistence is a SEPARATE temporal state from magnitude; exhaustion-mediated escape requires temporal persistence (not a single frame).

coefficient_policy.source: general tumour immune-evasion biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: escape dimensions consume blocked-potential ledgers where an upstream penalty already applied; the overall score is a shared-aggregation combination, never an undocumented shortcut.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No genetic escape / mutation inferred (excluded); microenvironmental + functional abstraction only.
